title: Howard Morland reconstructs the Teller-Ulam H-bomb design for The Progressive
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Howard Morland reconstructs the Teller-Ulam H-bomb design for The Progressive, about 1979 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: another guy named Howard Morland who heard that name >> who worked for the progressive magazine and he had the assignment see if you can figure out with no knowledge of physics the teller ulam design for the hydrogen bomb

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and commentator, tells of Howard Morland, a writer for a magazine called The Progressive, who around 1979 was given an odd assignment: with no physics training, work out the Teller-Ulam design, the closely guarded secret of how a hydrogen bomb works, which US laws called the Atomic Energy Acts kept classified. Weinstein tells it because it suggests a determined outsider can piece together a secret the government guards most tightly.
